description: Use first when you are unsure what VergeCommon can do on this connection: it says which tools are available, what this connection cannot do, and whether a personal agent token is in use. Do not use it to find co-ops or to calculate anything; use list_public_coops or the pooling draft tools for that. Returns the service origin, access level, token scopes, lists of available and unavailable capabilities and a short note, plus a source receipt and a link to start a co-op.
name: vergecommon_capabilities
